notes.title: Deadcam Demo Version 1.G is now available to play on Steam!
notes.content:
PLAY THE DEADCAM DEMO FOR FREE ON STEAM!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45696005/19ec4b502f8b73c9dfe11a81884e063cc1714101.png"]

This is the demo for Deadcam, Version V1.G. 



It's had some tweaks / patches. The full game is of course longer than the demo, and contains more mechanics, items, gameplay, and freedom. Wishlist Deadcam if you haven't already!
